main_text.p: [?]bem gressus ferebat, pleriq; anfractuosi ac difficiles, etiam cum muro non clauderetur. Imminebat urbi ab oriente Taygetus mons præruptus & excelsus ea parte, ex Arcadiæ finibus veniens, & Laconiam totam pene ufque ad mare meridiem versus percurrens, sed non pari altitudine, sæpè etiam valdè subsidens, & propemodum intermissus. Ad cujus radices labebatur fluvius Eurotas, gelidus,profundus,aquis majorem anni partem abundans, in eadem Arcadia juxta Alphæi fluminis alterius totâ Peloponnefo celeberrimi fontes ortus, & Laconiam à septentrione ingressus longoque tractu versus meridiem defluens, qua Spartam præterveliebatur, Taygeti radice radens, non longius sefquistadio ab eo in ortum distabat: dein reliquam regionem permeans in sinum maris, qui inter promontoria Maleam & Tænarum fundebatur, non procul Gytheo exibat.

page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment: only "bem" is legible at the start of the first line, continuing from the previous page; marked [?]. "FINIS" is printed with the I after the N missing, as "F I N S."; transcribed as printed. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. The printed "Peloponnefo" and "septentrione" etc. are normalised to plain s per the rules. Running head "DESCRIPTIO" and page number 416 are at the top of the page.
